summary: The revised frozen design closes RF-001 by binding each destructive approval to one exact outer command transaction: focused integration permits one runner invocation, while a complete local or CI V1 verification transaction permits at most two invocations and exactly two on success. Early-failure budget cannot be reused, every retry requires a fresh approval, cleanup remains contained to task-created temporary roots, and no live V2, Gate, persistence, push, merge, or deploy behavior is introduced.
